strings.preparednessDescription: Use these resources to prepare and put the right structures in place before a disaster strikes.
strings.groupCeaDescription: Actions to keep communities informed, engaged, and able to give feedback throughout the response
strings.barCea1Description: Use this to confirm who owns CEA for the response, from the NS, IFRC, or a PNS, before activities scale up.
strings.barCea2: Brief staff and volunteers on CEA
strings.barCea2Description: Run this briefing with staff, volunteers, and assessment teams so everyone applies CEA consistently in the field.
strings.barCea3Description: Follow this guidance to keep communities updated as the response evolves, on a regular cadence.
strings.barCea4Description: Reference this to decide how communities will be involved in shaping the response, not just informed about it.
strings.barCea5: Set up a community feedback mechanism
strings.barCea5Description: Set this up early so feedback can start flowing in and shaping decisions as the operation progresses.
strings.barCea6Description: Use this when planning closure, to make sure communities understand what's ending and what comes next.
strings.barCea7Description: Apply this to help the National Society turn short-term CEA work into a lasting capability.
strings.groupCommunicationsDescription: Steps to manage messaging, media relations, and public communications during the response
strings.barCommunications1Description: Use this to confirm who speaks for the operation at each level, so messaging stays consistent from the start.
strings.barCommunications2Description: Draft and issue this to put the humanitarian needs and RCRC's response on record early with media.
strings.barCommunications3Description: Reference this to align spokespeople on core messages and prepare responses to likely questions.
strings.barCommunications4Description: Build this out to guide how communications will run across the operation, not just in the first days.
strings.barCommunications5Description: Use this to collect and share materials (photos, stories, updates) through the right channels as they're produced.
strings.barCommunications6: Establish media and social media monitoring
strings.barCommunications6Description: Set this up to track coverage and public sentiment, so communications can adjust as the operation unfolds.
strings.groupCvaDescription: Guidance for planning, delivering, and monitoring cash and voucher assistance
strings.barCva1Description: Use this to assess needs and feasibility for cash and voucher assistance before designing the response.
strings.barCva2Description: Reference this to decide the right modality (cash, vouchers, or in-kind) based on the assessment findings.
strings.barCva3Description: Set this up to track whether CVA is reaching people as intended and adjust the approach as needed.
strings.barCva4: Implement accountability, registration, distribution, and others
strings.barCva4Description: Use this to guide day-to-day CVA delivery, covering accountability, registration, and distribution.
strings.groupGreenResponseDescription: Actions to reduce environmental impact and build climate resilience into the response
strings.barGreenResponse1Description: Use this to factor environmental risks into assessments and planning, and to prompt sector leads to explore greener solutions.
strings.barGreenResponse2Description: Run this screening to identify the environmental impacts of planned activities before they scale up.
strings.barGreenResponse3Description: Apply this to cut the environmental footprint of offices, warehouses, and logistics through energy efficiency, waste reduction, and sustainable procurement.
strings.barGreenResponse4Description: Use this to weave environmental messages into ongoing activities and encourage positive practices in communities.
strings.barGreenResponse5Description: Use this at transition to help the National Society carry environmental gains forward through a formal policy.
strings.groupHealthDescription: Steps to assess needs and deliver, adapt, and monitor health services
strings.barHealth1Description: Use this to work out what health personnel and equipment are needed, then request the right ERU or technical support.
strings.barHealth2Description: Run this assessment to map health needs against what RCRC can already deliver, and spot the gaps.
strings.barHealth3Description: Use this to guide how existing services are scaled up and new programming is shaped around emergency needs.
strings.barHealth4Description: Set this up to track health data quality and performance against KPIs throughout the response.
strings.barHealth5Description: Use this when planning the shift from emergency health response into recovery or longer-term programming.
strings.groupHumanitarianDiplomacyDescription: Stakeholder engagement and advocacy actions to support the response
strings.barHumanitarianDiplomacy1Description: Use this to identify key stakeholders and plan how to engage them, updating it as the operation evolves.
strings.barHumanitarianDiplomacy2Description: Reference this to keep advocacy messaging aligned with the issues that matter most as they emerge.
strings.barHumanitarianDiplomacy3Description: Set this up to log stakeholder positions and track engagements over time.
strings.barHumanitarianDiplomacy4Description: Use this to establish a coordination group that supports humanitarian diplomacy efforts across the operation.
strings.groupIdlDescription: Steps to secure humanitarian access and navigate legal/regulatory requirements
strings.barIdl1Description: Use this to formally request access from authorities so response activities can begin without delay.
strings.barIdl2Description: Build and maintain this factsheet to guide logistics and operations on legal and regulatory requirements.
strings.groupImDescription: Information management actions to support decision-making and reporting
strings.barIm1Description: Use this to assign the Surge Information Management System support needed for the operation.
strings.barIm2Description: Keep updating the GO platform, so that it reflects accurate, current information on the operation throughout its lifecycle.
strings.barIm3Description: Use this to keep decision-makers informed with a running picture of the situation as it develops.
strings.barIm4Description: Reference this to set the approach for how information will be managed and shared across the operation.
strings.barIm5Description: Use this to map which RCRC members are present and active in the response.
strings.groupLogisticsDescription: Steps to assess, plan, and manage supply chain, fleet, and procurement needs
strings.barLogistics1Description: Use this to assess infrastructure, damage, and access conditions before planning supply routes.
strings.barLogistics2Description: Set this up to track mobilization needs, and keep it updated as the operation evolves.
strings.barLogistics3Description: Use this to establish regular reporting on the status of the supply chain.
strings.barLogistics4Description: Reference this to work out what logistics surge personnel are needed for the response.
strings.barLogistics5Description: Use this to collect early needs data as the basis for a first draft procurement plan.
strings.barLogistics6Description: Build this plan to organize vehicle resources, including local rental options.
strings.barLogistics7Description: Use this to map out import routes, agents, warehousing, and transport for the operation.
strings.barLogistics8Description: Build this plan to guide what needs to be procured and how, based on identified needs.
strings.barLogistics9Description: Revisit this regularly to keep the procurement plan aligned with evolving operational needs.
strings.barLogistics10Description: Use this to begin mobilizing regional fleet resources once the fleet plan is in place.
strings.barLogistics11Description: Update this to align logistics planning with the operation's longer-term direction.
strings.groupMigrationDisplacementDescription: Guidance for responding to the needs of migrants and displaced populations
strings.barMigrationDisplacement1Description: Use these resources to guide the wind-down of the operation and the handover to longer-term plans.
strings.groupMonitoringEvaluationReportingDescri: Steps to track progress, report on the operation, and plan its evaluation
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting1Descrip: Use this to keep stakeholders updated with a sitrep every two days during the early response.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting2Descrip: Switch to this cadence to keep reporting continuously as the response stabilizes.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting3Descrip: Use this to produce the first formal operations update for the response.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting4Descrip: Build this plan to define how the operation's progress and results will be tracked.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting5Descrip: Use this to produce the second operations update as the response develops.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting6Descrip: Set this up to track indicators against the M&E plan as data comes in.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting7Descrip: Use this to carry out a Real-Time Evaluation and capture early lessons from the response.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting8Descrip: Use this to fulfill Federation-wide reporting requirements for the operation.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting9Descrip: Revisit this to update the M&E plan based on how the operation has evolved.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting10Descri: Use this to share decisions on the operation's direction in the 12-month update.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting11: Communicate decisions on the future of the operation
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting11Descri: Use this at transition to formally communicate what happens next for the operation.
strings.barMonitoringEvaluationReporting12Descri: Use this template to structure the final report for the operation.
strings.groupNsdDescription: Actions to strengthen National Society capacity throughout the response
strings.barNsd1Description: Use this to map what NSD support services are available to the National Society from the start.
strings.barNsd2Description: Run this review to quickly assess the National Society's development needs and existing capacities.
strings.barNsd3Description: Use this to set up and sustain a coordination structure for NSD throughout the operation.
strings.barNsd4Description: Use this to guide NSD priorities and keep a single NSD plan current as the operation progresses.
strings.groupPerDescription: Steps to assess and strengthen National Society preparedness and response capacity
strings.barPer1Description: Use this to assess where the National Society's response capacity currently stands.
strings.barPer2Description: Use this to plan targeted actions that build on the capacity gaps already identified.
strings.barPer3Description: Keep this running to track how NS response capacity evolves as the operation progresses.
strings.barPer4Description: Use this at closure to capture lessons learned and inform future operations.
strings.groupSafetySecurityDescription: Steps to assess risks and manage staff safety throughout the response
strings.barSafetySecurity1Description: Use this to assess security risks in the operating environment before deployment scales up.
strings.barSafetySecurity2Description: Build this plan to ensure medical evacuation procedures are in place if needed.
strings.barSafetySecurity3Description: Use this to set up a security management system meeting IFRC minimum requirements, especially where IFRC had no prior presence.
strings.barSafetySecurity4Description: Keep this running to track the security situation and adjust plans as conditions change.
strings.groupSprmDescription: Resource mobilization actions to fund and sustain the operation
strings.barSprm1Description: Set this up to track funding needs and status from the start of the operation.
strings.barSprm2Description: Use this to line up calls and briefings that introduce the Emergency Appeal to partners.
strings.barSprm3Description: Build this plan to guide resource mobilization efforts during the emergency phase.
strings.barSprm4Description: Use this to line up calls and briefings that present the Operational Strategy to partners.
strings.barSprm5Description: Keep this updated to reflect current funding and pledge status throughout the operation.
strings.barSprm6Description: Use this to help track pledges, donor requirements, and donor interest as they evolve.
strings.barSprm7Description: Use this to keep partners informed as the EA and OS are revised over time.
strings.barSprm8Description: Revisit this regularly to keep the RM plan and strategy aligned with the operation's needs.
strings.groupSurgeHrDescription: Steps to mobilize, manage, and support surge personnel throughout the response
strings.barSurgeHr1: Send surge alerts and mobilize personnel
strings.barSurgeHr1Description: Use this to trigger surge alerts and get the right personnel deployed quickly.
strings.barSurgeHr2Description: Use this to support staff well-being throughout the operation, not just at the start.
strings.barSurgeHr3Description: Reference this to understand how to raise and handle safeguarding concerns during the operation.
strings.barSurgeHr4: Plan workforce and identify HR priorities
strings.barSurgeHr4Description: Use this to plan workforce needs and align HR priorities with the National Society.
strings.barSurgeHr5Description: Use this to guide how staff are recruited and contracted for the operation.
strings.barSurgeHr6Description: Use this to ensure all End of Mission requirements are completed as staff roles wind down.
strings.barSurgeHr7Description: Use this to guide the induction and onboarding process for incoming staff.
